content: Yakube Iš loi uwafes dola or
Ar Yakube o nizor baisar uzu giye, edde Allar firista okkole hibar loi aiyore deha oiye.
Hitarare dekiyore Yakube hodde, "Itara Allar fouz okkol!" Hetolla he zagar nam diye Mahanaim.
Ar Yakube hibar ãgottu hóborguwa okkolore Seir elehat Edom maṛot Išor hãse defeṛaiye.
Yakube hitarare šikai diye, "Tũwara ãr malik Išore hoiye boli hoiba: 'Tũwar gulam Yakube hoiye: ãi Labonor hãse forbaš haiṭṭi edde etodin foijjonto heṛe aiššilam.
Ãttu goru gada sool berasool edde gulam edde bandi ase. Ar ãi ãr malike bala nozore saibo ei aša loi ãi ei hóborgan tũware hãse defeṛair.'"
Ar hóborguwa okkol Yakubor hãse firi aišše, hitara hodde, "Ãra tũwar bái Išor hãse gilam, ar hibaye o tũware fũwati sair šot manuš loi saito aiyer."
Toi Yakube beši ḍoraye edde dilot ouskus oiye, ar hibar fũwati aššilde hitarare edde hibar goru edde berasoolor zãk okkol, ũṭ okkolore dui grup goijje.
Toi hibaye hodde, "Iše zodi aiyore ek dolore hamela gore, ar ek dol ziba basi takibo hiba dái zaigoi faribo."
Toi Yakube hodde, "Oh Mabud, ãr fordada Ibrahimor Allah, ãr baf Isakor Allah, tũi zibaye ãre hoila, 'Tor dešot tor egena okkolor hãse tui firizagoi, ãi tor balai goijjium.'
Tũwar ei gulamor mikka ze hár rahamot edde imandari dehayo, hin hono kissur laikka ãi no, kiyollahoile uggwa hator laṛi loi ei Zordan farailam, kintu ehon ãttu dui dol oiye.
Aroz gori, ãr bái Išor hatottu ãre uddar goro, kiyollahoile ãi hitare ḍorai, ar zodi hite aiyore ãre edde ma-fuwaindore marifele.
Ar tũi to hoila, 'ãi tore balai goriyum edde tor bongšore doriyar balur renir ḍoilla beši goriyum, zin goni šeš gora no zaibo.'"
Toi Yakub he raitta heṛe rait haṛaiye, ar hibattu aššilde hinottu ek hadiya hisabe hibar bái Išolla loiye:
Dui šot sai sool edde kuriwa faṛa sool, dui šot miyala berasool edde kuriwa modda berasool,
so šoho dud dede hendilla tirišwa ũṭ, sališwa gai goru edde došwa bolod goru, ar kuriwa gadi edde došwa modda gada.
Bade hibaye hinore ek ekzon gulam okkolor hatot diye, toi hibar gulam okkolore hodde, "Tũwara ãr agottu farai zogoi, ar zãkor maze maze hoddur dur zaga farot raikko."
Bade hibaye foila zãkor hitare hokum diye: "Ãr bái Iš zodi tui loi deha o, edde fusar gore, 'Tui har gulam, hoṛe zodde, edde tor sarme asede in har?'
Toi tui hoibi, 'In tũwar gulam Yakubor, inore ek hadiya hisabe ãr malik Išor hãse faṭa oiye, so, hiba o ãrar fisottu ase.'"
Hibaye, dusora, tisera, edde aro oinno zara zãk loi zat aššil, hitara beggunore o hokum diye: "Iš loi deha oile tũwara o ekkui bafe ei hota hoiba.

Tũwara aro hoiba, 'So, tũwar gulam Yakub ãrar fisottu ase.'" Haron hibaye hodde, "Ãi ãr age ei hadiya okkol defeṛaiyore hibare šanto goijjium; toi bade ãi hibar siyara saiyum, oitofare hibaye ãre gosibo."
Toi hadiyagun hibar sarmottu fargora oil, kintu hiba nize he raitta dolor fũwati rait haṛaiye.
Yakubor kutsi edde hibar noya nam
Bade hiba he raitta uiṭṭe edde hibar dui bou, dui bandi edde hibar egaro futore loiye edde Jabbok gáṭ bai faraiye.
Hibaye hitarare hal fargorabai bade hibaye hibattu aššilde hár kissure far gorabaiye.
Toi Yakub heṛe eka roiye, edde ek zone hiba loi binna dol fohor ofan foijjonto kutsi doijje.
Kintu Yakubore hõṛai no farede dekiyore hibaye Yakubor kiyailor sunuti sai hamela goijje, ar henot hibar loi kutsi dorat Yakubor kiyailor sunuti zurattu niyoli giyegoi.
Toi hibaye hodde, "Binna dol fohor oiye, ebar ãre eride." Kintu Yakube hodde, "Ãre rahamot no goro foijjonto ãi tũware zaito no diyum."
Toi hibaye hodde, "Tor nam ki?" Hibaye hodde "Yakub."
Toi hibaye hodde, "Tore ar Yakub ḍaka no oibo, Israil ḍaka oibo, kiyollahoile tui Allah edde manuš loi zuddo goijjos edde tui zittos."
Hetunot Yakube fusar goredde, "Meherbani gori, õnor namman ho." Kintu hibaye hodde, "Ãr nam kiyolla fusar goror?" Toi hibaye hibare rahamot goijje.
Toi Yakube he zagar nam raikke Peniel, edde hodde, "Kiyollahoile ãi Allare sarma sarmi oi dekilam, tarfore o ãr foran baisse."
Bade hiba Peniel farai giyegoide šomot beil uiṭṭe edde hibar kiyailor sunutilla buli lenga šuru goijje.
Etolla iyan ehono foijjonto endilla ze Israili okkole kiyailor sunutir uwore ze gusto ase hin no há, kiyollahoile Yakubor kiyailor sunutir gusto sai hamela gora oil.
